reviews.title: Not good
reviews.text: I purchased the premium package with the traffic & cameras, since i bought it with my iCloud i change the devices and now is asking to buy again. I don’t want to even elaborate how outdated are the maps. I asked the customer support to create me an Sygic account with the purchase to use on the new phone, they weren’t helpful

reviews.title: A FUIR !!
reviews.text:
Au prix de 100€ ( avec option CarPlay) déjà ça c’est une honte de faire payer l’option.
De plus il n’y a pas les infos en direct sur le trajet lors de travaux ou autre, alors que TOUT les autres gps en sont doté, même ceux gratuit. 
Si j’aurais su jamais de la vie j’aurais payé pour un service aussi déplorable. Quand au trajet, en tant que conducteur SPL c’est vraiment pas ça non plus, ça fait des détours complètement inutile, bref à fuir

reviews.title: Inaccurate map data
reviews.text: Frustratingly, Sygic has vastly inaccurate maps for our area with loads of roads with inaccurate speed limits. Outside of navigation mode, you can’t see the data for the roads so can’t verify the correct information is being used. This gives me little faith in Sygic. Wish I’d never paid for it.

reviews.title: Pas content
reviews.text:
J’ai acheté cette application pour m’aider dans la conduite d’un camping car de location. Malgré un paramétrage soigneux des dimensions poids du camping car, L’application m’a dirigé vers un passage interdit aux plus de 3m20 de haut (3m25) dans mon cas,  que j’ai eu bien du mal à contourner . Le même jour l’application m’a dirigé vers une rue étroite à Martel où un passant m’a aider à me sortir de la difficulté de passage. Hier l’application a voulu me faire prendre une route non carrossable. Finalement cela m’a dégoûté d’acheter un camping car. Je faisais un test avec une 
Location avant de passer à un achat. Les frayeurs occasionnées par le guidage m’en ont dissuadé. Cela s’est finalement beaucoup mieux passé avec une application gps classique que j’ai fini par réutiliser.

reviews.title: Horrible

reviews.title: Application soi-disant gratuite… jusqu’au moment où l’on veut réellement s’en servir ! 😡
reviews.text:
On télécharge, on prend le temps de l’installer, qui plus est prend de la place dans la mémoire du téléphone et au final : abonnement obligatoire pour accéder aux fonctionnalités intéressantes. Pour un GPS poids lourd, ce n’est franchement pas très transparent.

Si l’application est payante, dites-le clairement dès le départ au lieu de l’afficher comme gratuite. Personnellement, je trouve cette façon de faire particulièrement trompeuse. Grosse déception, désinstallée aussi vite qu’elle a été installée. 👎

reviews.title: Awful- worse than having no navigation app
reviews.text:
Having had a few epics on UK country lanes with our 13m single axle caravan rig, I decided to invest in the high cost for this app. It is recommended in many caravan forums. 
It is shockingly bad, inaccurate and continues to suggest totally inappropriate routes with impossible turns and narrow damaging lanes. I have set the vehicle measurements correctly and there seems to be no intelligence behind the route finding. 
AVOID AT ALL COSTS. I’d like a refund but suspect that won’t happen.

reviews.title: Incomplete trial
reviews.text: Downloaded app. Looked interesting and had lots of good offers to upgrade however the trial did not include CarPlay which is absolutely critical to me so I could not objectively evaluate whether it was suitable for my setup… so have not progressed.

reviews.title: Terrible. Avoid.
reviews.text:
I wish I could give zero stars. Used it for a while where we were relatively local and there was the odd time where it tried to take me places I knew were unsuitable. 
Used it for the first full tour in our Motorhome and ended up on top of a Welsh Mountain having driven along roads that were about a centimetre wider than the van with no passing places and ended at a gate. Had to reverse half a mile back the same narrow roads before I could find a flat piece of grass to turn on. 
Do not pay for this app. It is terrible. 
Simply put your vehicle into Gemini and tell it where you want to go and it will create a route for you that you can export to google maps.

reviews.title: Doesn’t care about HGV
reviews.text: Thinking on going back to TomTom when my license expires, even though you enter your lorry dimensions and weight, it keeps sending you through roads you can barely drive a car. Not to mention every time you reinstall the app all your Favourites Locations disappear… One star is too much.

reviews.title: Horrible Interface & Unusable
reviews.text: Horrible 1980s interface with the search function that does not work. Asked to enter country but nothing listed which prevents searching for cities, etc.  And 7 day trial is not enough time to try even if it did work. Uninstalled.

reviews.title: Mauvaise expérience

reviews.title: Questionable Routing

Needs a serious update. Misses loads of roundabouts, tells you to turn right, when the road simply bends to the right and send you off down single tracks roads with the hendges brushing wash side of the motorhome. 

It’s only useful to compare its height and weight based calculated routes with Soemthing like Waze, then use that!

reviews.title: Dangerous

Tried to send me down several tight lanes when normal apps offering safer route. It even tried to send me down a 6ft width when I input 7ft 9”.
The last time I used it I damaged my motorhome step  which will be costly. Shameful useless dangerous app. DO NOT BOTHER !!!

I bought this having been frustrated with TomTom, google and Waze. I realise that google and Waze don’t do large vehicles, mine is a motorhome, but TomTom and Sygic do. Only used this Sygic app 3 times and twice it has tried to send us down I made tracks!!

reviews.title: Road width warning too late
reviews.text:
I was in the Isle of Wight and wanted to go to Newtown to visit a nature reserve but it wasn’t until I was almost there that the app notified me that the next road is too narrow and I cannot continue. 

So I looked for another point of interest in the north east coast and once again, got almost there only to be told by the app that the road is too narrow which meant I didn’t go there. 

Why doesn’t the app warn before we start the long journey that the final road is impassable with this vehicle which would have saved two wasted trips and fuel.

reviews.title: Rubbish
reviews.text:
So I purchased Sygic caravan for £74.99. Worst app I’ve purchased for touring with my caravan! It asks you to submit your vehicle dimensions, which means you’d think it would not only find the correct route but also the correct speed limits. First trip out whilst using the app, it tried to send me down a road in Cumbria that is only suitable for 4x4 cars MINUS a caravan, not towing one. It also was indicating speed limits based on a car without a large caravan. Obviously the driver should know the limits per each vehicle, but if you’re driving in a foreign country, it should display correctly. I went on the website to request a refund but there is no option!
Unfortunately, Copilot GPS doesn’t support CarPlay, because I’d definitely buy that instead!

reviews.title: Needs work
reviews.text:
I bought the app to use with carplay, but the map is barely visible because of a huge red box obscuring it, the sound doesn’t work so get no verbal instructions, the gps is very flaky, approaching roundabouts the distance will jump up and down, a lot of the speed limits shown on the map are wrong, it doesn’t remember previous destinations.
The worse thing, I tried it out on local roads which I’m familiar with and it’s trying to route me down roads that are wholly unsuitable for caravans - unless your aim is to destroy it.
The app needs a lot of work to be worth the £69.99 it cost.

reviews.title: Not work any more
reviews.text:
I live in Los Angeles, California, and the app cannot connect to the Sygic server on either my home Wi‑Fi or my AT&T mobile data. It only works if I use a VPN. My other Sygic app (the regular navigation version) has no issues, so the problem seems specific to the Truck & RV Navigation app.

Even when I use a VPN and successfully connect to download maps, the app gets stuck on the map‑downloading screen. I already downloaded the California map, but the system will not let me proceed to the navigation stage. I tried uninstalling and reinstalling, but the issue remains.

I then increased the size of the motorhome in the app hoping this would then avoid unsuitable roads but on the next journey it took us down a road that turned out to be way too narrow and scratched our new van up with rough cut trees and bushes trying to avoid a stone wall on the other side. I’m glad I didn’t pay for the privilege.

reviews.title: Not working for me at all
reviews.text: I was looking for an app where I could put in the dimensions for my car and horse trailer and get realistic trip estimations based on the vehicle/trailer size, and tempo restrictions. This seemed like the perfect solution. Unfortunately it is not. Once it is connected to Apple car play you can’t change anything on the screen display, it has the weirdest slowest voice to give directions, but even worse - you pay for premium features but then the app won’t let you log in , can’t connect, crashes .. so you can’t use the premium features .. I had such high hope but it looks to me that this app needs some serious work do e. Very unfortunate.

reviews.title: Awful, do not download
reviews.text:
I bought this to route me from Cornwall to a Devon village in a remote place. 
Setup the width, height etc in the app (which was a struggle as the inputs are buggy as hell)
Set my waypoints in the clunky old-fashioned interface and off I went.  
First thing it did was take me through a tiny city centre which was too tight for the coach, then it tried to take my 12’ tall coach under an 11’6” bridge.  
Along with randomly forgetting the route and needing to be reprogrammed and randomly shoving a full page over the route as you’re driving that you have to dismiss its a hard pass.  
Do NOT download this trash.

reviews.title: Très mauvais CarPlay
reviews.text: J’avais initialement acheté une licence pour mon autoradio Androïd. L’application ne fonctionne pas sur autoradio (confirmé par le support). Du coup, obligé de l’utiliser en CarPlay. Non seulement, les indications sont très succinctes (n’affiche pas le nom de la direction à prendre, ni les stations service, parkings,…) mais en plus vous perdez l’affichage sur l’iPhone (juste un affichage connecté à CarPlay disponible) donc vous ne pouvez pas changer votre itinéraire en passant par un POI par exemple sans déconnecter le CarPlay. De plus, les informations de vitesses limites sont fantaisistes (80 au lieu de 110 sur 4 voies pendant des dizaines de km, limitations à 90 furtives sur autoroute, je ne compte plus le nombres d’erreurs sur un simple trajet caen-St Malo, ça a été n’importe quoi tout du long avec un profil fourgon). J’utilise également Sygic classique qui est lui très bien mais cette version camping car est à fuir. Bref, 80€ à la poubelle pour une appli GpS plus énervante que rendant service.

reviews.title: Outdated
reviews.text: This app used to be good but not anymore. Desperately needs updating especially with the roundabouts. Takes you off the main roads and sends you down narrow country roads, sometimes roads that clearly are not used by HGV’s as lots of low hanging branches and don’t even get me started on my poor wing mirror. Doesn’t reroute if you have to come off due to diverted traffic, just continues to tell you to make a U-turn which is highly annoying when you can’t just pull over to find an alternative route. Cannot believe I spent £80 buying this app, would love my money back as it’s not fit for purpose and causes me so much unnecessary stress. Now I have to pay for another more reliable truck sat nav. Until they update and improve then please don’t waste your money on this app.

The other day it sent me to a bridge it was not allowed more than 7.5T and I was going with an 18T truck and I had put the details of the truck and still sent it to that bridge. reviews.title: Trash company. No support
reviews.text: Lost my lifetime license due to their apparent mismanagement of their own system. Two months of a lifetime membership, lost license and the support email that basically says, “sorry about your bad luck. Sucks to suck. Please reply if you need anything else.” How about you stop ghosting my emails and provide a paying customer with, at the very least, a legitimate reason why my purchase cannot be restored. One more unanswered email and I’ll move past your sham of a support system to find somebody who will actually assist me in this manner. Does Slovakia even have regulatory agencies?

reviews.title: Waste of money
reviews.text:
Needed an RV specific system to work with Carplay.  This seemed to be the answer ... was I wrong!!  1.  Little to no instructions or help files
2.  Voice directions break up and never hear full navigation instructions 
3.  Fails to recalculate directions when off course.
4.  Trying to locate an address to navigate to is cumbersome and error prone with lack of recognized businesses/addresses.
5.  No way to try out the Rv and Carplay features without buying license.  Now I am out $78 as this system is useless for me.
